px-[24px] py-[60px]"><header class="mb-[40px]"><h1 class="text-[36px] font-[600] leading-[1.3] text-brand-1 mb-[16px]">MiniMax M2.1: Significantly Enhanced Multi-Language Programming, Built for Real-World Complex Tasks</h1><div class="flex items-center gap-[16px] text-[14px] text-[#86909C]"><time>2025-12-23</time></div><div class="flex gap-[8px] mt-[16px] flex-wrap"><span class="px-[10px] py-[4px] text-[12px] bg-[#F4F4F4] text-zinc-700 rounded-[6px]">AI</span><span class="px-[10px] py-[4px] text-[12px] bg-[#F4F4F4] text-zinc-700 rounded-[6px]">Coding</span></div></header><div class="prose max-w-none text-[16px] leading-[1.8] text-brand-1"><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax has been continuously transforming itself in a more AI-native way. The core driving forces of this process are models, Agent scaffolding, and organization. Today we are releasing updates to the model component, namely MiniMax M2.1, hoping to help more enterprises and individuals find more AI-native ways of working (and living) sooner.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">In M2, we primarily addressed issues of model cost and model accessibility. In M2.1, we are committed to improving performance in real-world complex tasks: focusing particularly on usability across more programming languages and office scenarios, and achieving the best level in this domain.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/e6d16697-81be-4fc0-9c4d-3fe73d993881.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>Key Highlights of MiniMax M2.1</strong></h2><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Exceptional Multi-Programming Language Capabilities</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Many models in the past primarily focused on Python optimization, but real-world systems are often the result of multi-language collaboration. In M2.1, we have systematically enhanced capabilities in Rust, Java, Golang, C++, Kotlin, Objective-C, TypeScript, JavaScript, and other languages. The overall performance on multi-language tasks has reached industry-leading levels, covering the complete chain from low-level system development to application layer development.</p><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>WebDev and AppDev: A Comprehensive Leap in Capability and Aesthetics</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Addressing the widely recognized weakness in mobile development across the industry, M2.1 significantly strengthens native Android and iOS development capabilities. Meanwhile, we have systematically enhanced the model&#x27;s design comprehension and aesthetic expression in Web and App scenarios, enabling excellent construction of complex interactions, 3D scientific scene simulations, and high-quality visualization, making vibe coding a sustainable and deliverable production practice.</p><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Enhanced Composite Instruction Constraints, Enabling Office Scenarios</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">As one of the first open-source model series to systematically introduce Interleaved Thinking, M2.1&#x27;s systematic problem-solving capabilities have been further upgraded. The model not only focuses on code execution correctness but also emphasizes integrated execution of composite instruction constraints, providing higher usability in real office scenarios.</p><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>More Concise and Efficient Responses</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Compared to M2, MiniMax-M2.1 delivers more concise model responses and thought chains. In practical programming and interaction experiences, response speed has significantly improved and token consumption has notably decreased, resulting in smoother and more efficient performance in AI Coding and Agent-driven continuous workflows.</p><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Outstanding Agent/Tool Scaffolding Generalization Capabilities</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 demonstrates excellent performance across various programming tools and Agent frameworks. It exhibits consistent and stable results in tools such as Claude Code, Droid (Factory AI), Cline, Kilo Code, Roo Code, and BlackBox, while providing reliable support for Context Management mechanisms including Skill.md, Claude.md/agent.md/cursorrule, and Slash Commands.</p><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>High-Quality Dialogue and Writing </strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 is no longer just stronger in coding capabilities. In everyday conversation, technical documentation, and writing scenarios, it also provides more detailed and structured responses.</p><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>Benchmarks</strong></h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax-M2.1 delivers a significant leap over M2 on core software engineering leaderboards. It shines particularly bright in multilingual scenarios, where it outperforms Claude Sonnet 4.5 and closely approaches Claude Opus 4.5.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/87207db5-98a2-4236-83ef-5a124af574b5.png" alt="Benchmark comparison chart" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">We also evaluated MiniMax-M2.1 on SWE-bench Verified across a variety of coding agent frameworks. The results highlight the model&#x27;s exceptional framework generalization and robust stability.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/20ab951e-21b5-4144-925b-14f6597b5d1c.png" alt="SWE-bench Verified results" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Furthermore, across specific benchmarks—including test case generation, code performance optimization, code review, and instruction following—MiniMax-M2.1 demonstrates comprehensive improvements over M2. In these specialized domains, it consistently matches or exceeds the performance of Claude Sonnet 4.5.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/12998d55-6f9c-4f97-be6a-37847f004609.png" alt="Specialized benchmark results" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">To evaluate the model&#x27;s full-stack capability to architect complete, functional applications from zero to one, we established a novel benchmark: VIBE (Visual &amp; Interactive Benchmark for Execution). This suite encompasses five core subsets: Web, Simulation, Android, iOS, and Backend.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/e26bd78c-3ab9-4fd9-9c31-72d6d37d829d.png" alt="VIBE benchmark introduction" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax-M2.1 delivers outstanding performance on the VIBE aggregate benchmark, achieving an average score of 88.6—demonstrating robust full-stack development capabilities.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/0890153c-df2f-456b-bbb3-538cf95c3c36.png" alt="VIBE benchmark results" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/a6b76769-1851-4055-bb1d-ef7a809cccf4.png" alt="VIBE detailed results" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>Showcases</strong></h2><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Multilingual Coding</strong></h3><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/d54bc49b-16e0-4ead-a34c-75b6c0b74187.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>3D Interactive Animation</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">MiniMax M2.1 built a 3D Dreamy Christmas Tree based on React Three Fiber and InstancedMesh, successfully rendering over 7,000 instances. It supports gesture interaction and complex particle animation, demonstrating advanced 3D rendering capabilities.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/b7f24d90-0682-4738-893b-822ea16d1b9e.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Avant-Garde Web UI Design</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 generated a minimalist photographer&#x27;s personal homepage using an asymmetrical layout and a black-white-red contrasting color scheme. By combining immersive imagery with brutalist typography, it achieved a high-impact visual effect.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/d5d2e9f5-6add-4990-8adc-3ef6cd3790af.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Website - Skincare Brand</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 designed a landing page for a high-end organic skincare brand. Adopting a Clean &amp; Minimalist style, it accurately presented the brand&#x27;s premium identity and international visual appeal.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/2b047234-d139-4389-8da9-20332fe1b7c0.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Web 3D Lego Sandbox</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 developed a high-freedom 3D brick building application based on Three.js, implementing precise grid snapping algorithms and collision detection mechanisms. The project perfectly replicates the glossy texture of plastic bricks, supporting multi-angle rotation, drag-and-drop assembly, and instant color switching.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/594bdcf8-3885-422c-a4f2-1018b76380cf.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Native App Development - Android</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 used Kotlin to develop a native Android gravity sensor simulator. Utilizing the gyroscope for a silky-smooth control experience, it features clever visual easter eggs that elegantly present the MERRY XMAS MiniMax M2.1 message through natural UI transitions and collision effects.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/7e03de83-7de4-4cea-aade-ff41cda7baec.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Native App Development - iOS</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 wrote an interactive iOS Home Screen widget, designing a Sleeping Santa click-to-wake mechanism. The logic is complete with native-level animation effects.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/ba842e3d-f53e-41d9-bd09-08b6cbacafe9.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Web Audio Simulation Development</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 developed a 16-step drum machine simulator based on the Web Audio API. It integrates synthesized drum sounds, non-linear rhythm algorithms, and real-time glitch sound effects, providing an avant-garde electronic music experience.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/7d867f07-9289-4b30-b0e5-05d05c3d5291.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Rust TUI</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 built a powerful Linux security audit tool with dual CLI + TUI modes using Rust, supporting one-click low-level scanning and intelligent risk rating for critical items such as processes, networks, and SSH.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/8b4dfc3c-0792-4bfe-87f1-917a9cd087a8.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Python Data Dashboard</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 created a Web3 cryptocurrency price dashboard in the style of The Matrix. Using Python for real-time price API fetching, HTML structure, and CSS with Matrix aesthetic: green digital rain on black background, monospaced font, glowing neon green text, terminal-like UI.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/ffdcf6ae-32a2-4724-9cc2-e1c01fcff605.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>C++ Image Rendering</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 utilized C++ and GLSL to implement complex light transport algorithms, accurately rendering the physical refraction of a crystal ball, detailed SDF modeling of a snowman, and shimmering snow effects in a real-time environment.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/d60b85e3-1e25-4e2d-942a-f7f9784733c7.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Java Real-time Danmaku</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 implemented a high-performance real-time Danmaku (bullet chat) system based on Java, a clean and intuitive user interface, and millisecond-level response capabilities.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/7efd9d2d-2753-4a30-a709-35b5f2081ab2.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>SVG Generation</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 generated an interactive isometric SVG island map, constructing a detailed miniature world that supports one-click zooming to freely explore four major themed areas.</p><div class="html-block"><img src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/4e6a335f-2194-4c09-b8db-1dc7b1aa2b5d.png" alt="SVG island map" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px" /></div><h3 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-3 mt-5"><strong>Agentic Tool Use</strong></h3><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">M2.1 demonstrated its tool-use capabilities by autonomously invoking Excel and Yahoo Finance to complete an end-to-end task, ranging from market research data cleaning and analysis to chart generation.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/8f7d25d2-07a4-4120-8168-551219617946.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>Digital Employee</strong></h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">The Digital Employee is a key feature of the MiniMax M2.1 model. M2.1 accepts web content presented in text form and controls mouse clicks and keyboard inputs via text-based commands. It can complete end-to-end tasks in daily office scenarios across administration, data science, finance, human resources, and software development.</p><div class="html-block"><video controls style="max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;margin:12px 0;border-radius:12px"><source src="https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/626ed5d2-2ffa-4773-8a15-0b0991f357cc.mp4" type="video/mp4"></source></video></div><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>Local Deployment Guide</strong></h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Download the model from the HuggingFace repository. We recommend using the following inference frameworks to serve the model: SGLang, vLLM, Transformers, and Ktransformers.</p><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">Recommended inference parameters: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=40</p><h2 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-4 mt-6"><strong>How to Use</strong></h2><p class="mb-4 leading-relaxed">The MiniMax-M2.1 API is now live on the MiniMax Open Platform. Our product MiniMax Agent, built on MiniMax-M2.1, is now publicly available. The MiniMax-M2.1 model weights are now open-source, allowing for local deployment and use.</p></div></article><footer class="bg-black px-6 md:px-[60px] pt-20 pb-10"><div class="max-w-[1920px]
